hints: The heart and the servings buttons are reached with Tab and the stars are not. Compare the elements: open the developer tools on a star and on the heart, and see which HTML element each one is. The browser decides what gets the focus and what Space does from the element itself.

The stars are drawn by `client/src/components/RatingStars.tsx` as `<span>` elements with an `onClick`. A span is plain text for the browser: it is not in the Tab order, a key press does not click it, and assistive technology is not told it does anything. The `title` only shows a tooltip for the mouse.

Make each star a `<button type="button">`: buttons are focusable, Space and Enter click them, and a screen reader announces them. Give each one `aria-label` with `1 star`, `2 stars`… (keep the `title` if you like), mark the ★ glyph inside as `aria-hidden`, and pass `disabled` to the button instead of ignoring the click by hand. Group them with `role="group"` and `aria-label="Rate this recipe"`. The focus ring comes from the `:focus-visible` rule of `styles.css`. The preview that fills the stars on hover can also follow the focus (`onFocus`/`onBlur`).
